results.title: The Mirror of Simple Souls
results.overview: A meditation on family and illness created from a series of looping stop-motion animations, found footage and 35mm colour reversal slides.

results.title: Zoey & Ben
results.overview: Unsuccessful actor Ben unexpectedly becomes the full-time parent of his nine-year-old daughter, Zoey, whom he has only seen every other weekend, after her mother is hospitalized following an overdose. Shot over a span of ten years, ZOEY & BEN follows their journey through life's triumphs and setbacks, charting Ben's transformation from a self-absorbed dreamer into a compassionate family man, and Zoey's evolution from a traumatized little girl into a confident young woman.

results.overview: A new movie from CVN team

results.title: Drury Lane
results.overview: A flat tire leaves realtor James stranded on the side of the road. He’s now at the mercy of a stranger who finds himself on the same road, on the same night, at the same time…

results.title: Beware of Loss
results.overview: As children, we all had something that once felt like the most precious thing in the world. For the protagonist, it was a toy that was always by their side. Yet now, having grown up, they find themselves no longer cherishing that toy as they once did.  “Why do we eventually forget the toys that once meant the most to us?”  Through the documentary, we explore how the things we hold dear change as we grow. In the place once occupied by a beloved toy, other precious things have taken its place—friends, family, relationships, and memories.

results.title: Selfie: The Possible Lives
results.overview: Ten years after Selfie (2019), Ferrante goes back to Rione Traiano in Naples diving in the frames that were cut out. He finds a choir of vital and restless teenagers, and asks himself not what kind of the life did they had, but what kind of life they could've had.

results.title: Concordia Norte
results.overview: In a gated community, a security guard and a young woman with marital troubles develop an unexpected friendship.

results.title: 5 Days With Boy5
results.overview: An interviewer spends 5 days following a passionate singer as he prepares his questionable dynamic of a boy band for the biggest performance of their career.

results.title: Manual Wind
results.overview: Carlos, a young funeral home worker, steals belongings from the dead. When he secretly sells his late father's watch, the object begins a journey that connects several lives across Mexico City, while tensions with his brother continue to grow.

results.title: Torus
results.overview: In the distant future, the pilot of an illegal scrapping spacecraft recounts her experiences growing up in the slums of an industrial space station.

results.title: Never Sleep
results.overview: Following the sudden death of their father, a restless teen in the midst of a queer self-discovery bonds with their estranged aunt over their fraught relationships with death, loss and familial responsibility.

results.title: Forza on the Run
results.overview: Heavy Weekend 02: The French police have put the illegal drift racers of Paris on final notice, so they've took off on the run across the border into Belgium. Hanrahan rides along with the crew as they dodge police and takeover Brussels.

results.title: Spring in Imroz
results.overview: The narrative follows the emotional journey of two distinct individuals whose paths unexpectedly cross on the island, forcing them to confront the heavy shadows of their pasts while discovering the profound possibility of a "second spring" or love being reborn.

results.title: Pinball Beyond the Bumpers
results.overview: Pinball is a phenomenon loved all over the world.  Follow the “silver ball” from the 1600’s to the resurgence today with never-before-seen footage of rare games, rock stars, celebrities, past and present gaming legends, and more!

results.title: Unbound Voices
results.overview: Village cadre Zhou Qinzhi and volunteer teacher Feng Ji overcame difficulties together to set up a choir, enabling girls in the mountainous areas to grow up amid life’s hardships and care from society.

results.title: Menino Ávio
results.overview: After a heated family confrontation, Otávio runs away from home in the dead of night and crosses the city toward the local gay nightclub. Amid hazy lights and dreamlike encounters, he embarks on a spiritual journey that reshapes the way he sees himself.
